faq.title: Your questions.
faq.a1: SVG, PNG, WebP or JPEG, up to 10 MB (5 MB for an SVG). The file is checked and sanitised before anything reads it; the original stays private.
faq.q2: Do the colours really come from my logo?
faq.a2: Yes: the palette is extracted from the logo's pixels, then each colour gets a role. A colour completed by the engine is marked “derived”.
faq.a3: Never. Variants are computed from your file, and mockups project it as it is onto the photograph.
faq.a4: It is computed per WCAG 2.2 on the exact value. When a colour is not readable as text, the copilot proposes the closest lightness that passes, with the resulting ratio.
faq.a5: Colours, typefaces, texts, each page's format and background: every change is a saved command you can undo or redo.
faq.a6: The guideline as PDF, the logo files, CSS and Tailwind variables, and W3C design tokens you can import into Figma.
faq.q7: I am a designer: what do I gain?
faq.a7: The systematic part of a guideline (palette, contrast, versions, rules, mockups, files) is done in minutes. Your time goes to judgement: you take over every page by hand.
